newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise in Argentina water supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise in Argentina water supply deal.

text.p: French utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Tuesday a consortium in which it held a leading share had won a 30-year concession to distribute drinking water in the Argentine town of Cordoba.
It said in a statement the concession, operated by Lyonnaise itself, would generate turnover of around $50-60 million a year.
A spokeswoman said a third of this sum would be consolidated into the group's results.
Lynonaise did not say when the concession would be up and running.
